# Step - add_e

`add_e` · `addE` · category: [Changing the graph](../../traversal/step_reference.md#changing-the-graph)

Adds an edge with the given label; its endpoints come from from() and to() (see the book page addE() Endpoints).

## Forms

```text
add_e()
add_e(arg1: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).add_e("likes").to("3").label().next()   // likes
```
